project_type: TypeScript / Node 22 ESM MCP server (superset of Playwright MCP) with a local @receptron/laya on-device ONNX decision engine plus deterministic rules and MCP-sampling LLM escalation.
build_system: pnpm. Node is provided by nvm (v22.23.2). `node`/`pnpm` are NOT on the bare PATH; a login shell (`bash -lc '...'`) resolves them. tsc for build/typecheck; vitest for tests.
test_framework: vitest (vitest run). Real headless Chromium is used by many tests. Real-weights tests are gated behind LAYA_MODEL_DIR and self-skip when absent. A cross-browser Firefox smoke test really launches Firefox.
build_command: bash -lc 'pnpm run build' (tsc). Typecheck: bash -lc 'pnpm run typecheck'.
verification_instructions: 1) bash -lc 'pnpm run typecheck' (must be clean). 2) bash -lc 'pnpm run build' (tsc exit 0). 3) bash -lc 'pnpm test' (vitest). Baseline established this session is GREEN: 42 files, 301 passed, 3 skipped, after installing Playwright browsers (chromium + firefox). The 3 skips are WebKit self-skip (missing system libs) and two LAYA_MODEL_DIR-gated blocks. Optional: bash -lc 'pnpm run bench' (offline vitest report) should stay green.
snapshot_or_generated_files: benchmark/RESULTS.md, benchmark/results.json, benchmark/charts/ are produced by `pnpm run bench:compare` / `pnpm run bench:fastloop`; they are checked in but only regenerate on explicit bench runs. No source snapshots. Model weights (*.onnx / *.onnx.data / model/ / .venv / .cache) are gitignored and must NEVER be committed.
setup_instructions: Playwright browsers are required for the test suite. Run: bash -lc 'pnpm exec playwright install chromium' and 'pnpm exec playwright install firefox'. (--with-deps fails here: apt-get is absent, but the browsers launch anyway.) node_modules are already installed. onnxruntime-node@1.30.0 is present as a transitive dep of @receptron/laya.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET. NO NVIDIA GPU in this sandbox: CUDA / DirectML / WebGPU execution providers CANNOT be exercised here. The EP-selection resolver, probe, and fall-through logic and the CPU path are implemented and UNIT-TESTED with a fake session factory; the actual GPU speedup is UNVERIFIABLE here and must be labelled to-be-measured on the user's RTX 4050, with an exact reproduce command + the startup log line that names the engaged EP. Do NOT fabricate a GPU number. Python 3.12 via `uv` (/root/.local/bin/uv) is available for the int8 quantization / export path.
contribution_requirements: STYLE: NO EM DASHES anywhere in written content (README/docs/comments/scripts/prose) - use hyphens or parentheticals. Keep src/types.ts PURE (no playwright/onnx imports). Config parsed ONCE in src/config.ts (env + overrides + bounds/defaults). Guard untrusted boundaries (page.evaluate output, LLM answers). Make illegal states unrepresentable (discriminated Decision union). docs/PLAN.md is the authoritative design log and carries a verified/inferred/guessed ledger - every claim needs evidence or a measured/inferred/guess label.
key_patterns: Boundary discipline: types pure; config once; Playwright confined to src/browser.ts + src/snapshot.ts; ONNX/@receptron/laya confined to src/laya/engine.ts; escalation depends on an injected SampleFn (unit-testable without a live client). Decision pipeline in src/autopilot/loop.ts: rule seed (policy.ts, RULE_CONFIDENCE 0.97) -> Laya narrow decide (engine.ts, TWO choice questions in one systemOne pass) -> confidence check vs 0.85 gate (OR semantics) -> escalate() to client LLM. escalate() (src/autopilot/escalation.ts) threads the pre-escalation decision as options.fallback; when the LLM is unreachable AND fallback.operation !== 'BLOCKED' it returns the fallback (escalated:false) - this is exactly the filter that traps a low-confidence BLOCKED. Laya.load (node_modules/@receptron/laya/dist/laya.js line 43) creates the ort session with `executionProviders: opts.executionProviders ?? ['cpu']` - a broken listed EP makes InferenceSession.create THROW, so a candidate probe = a real load attempt that either succeeds or throws to fall through.
relevant_files: docs/PLAN.md (authoritative design log + ledger; READ FIRST)
src/config.ts (single parse point; ~30 LAYA_* env knobs; executionProviders parsed but never resolved to a GPU EP; fastLoop/fastWaitCapMs live here)
src/laya/engine.ts (LayaEngine.load forwards executionProviders to Laya.load; decide = 2 choice questions)
src/laya/index.ts (createEngine factory; the wiring point for EP resolution and the load-once behavior)
src/index.ts (bin; builds engine from config, logs 'Autopilot engine loaded' - the place to log the engaged EP)
src/autopilot/escalation.ts (~escalate(): the fallback filter `options.fallback.operation !== 'BLOCKED'` that drops a low-confidence BLOCKED => dead-end)
src/autopilot/loop.ts (2038 lines; decision pipeline; no-weights BLOCKED placeholder ~line 1575; fastLoop/legacy branching at ~1289-1900 incl. F4 speculative-decision reuse gated on fastLoop)
src/autopilot/policy.ts (deterministic rule layer, policySeed, RULE_CONFIDENCE 0.97 - the reliable path that STAYS)
src/server.ts (threads config.fastLoop/fastWaitCapMs + all loop options into the run_goal tool ctx)
src/tools/run_goal.ts (RunGoalContext carries fastLoop/fastWaitCapMs and every loop knob)
src/snapshot.ts (capture + captureFast; fast-loop atomic snapshot lives here)
src/browser.ts (Playwright lifecycle; imports captureFast; fast-loop act-time freshness/occlusion)
scripts/prepare-model.sh (reference | web-agent bundle builder; add an int8 path here)
test/config.test.ts, test/escalation.test.ts, test/autopilot-autonomy-t1-t5.test.ts, test/fast-loop.test.ts (existing tests to keep green / extend)
node_modules/@receptron/laya/dist/laya.js (the ort.InferenceSession.create EP call site - read-only reference)
directory_structure: src/ (config.ts, index.ts bin, server.ts, browser.ts, snapshot.ts, state-builder.ts, types.ts pure, safety.ts, redact.ts, overlay.ts, snapshot-diff.ts); src/laya/ (engine.ts, index.ts factory, stub.ts, goal.ts); src/autopilot/ (loop.ts, policy.ts, escalation.ts, dismiss.ts); src/tools/ (71 registered MCP tools + registry.ts + index.ts). test/ (vitest). benchmark/ (compare.mjs head-to-head, before-after.mjs fast-loop, fixtures/, RESULTS.md, results.json). scripts/prepare-model.sh. docs/PLAN.md.
